metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent configured Thunderbird SMTP with port 587 and STARTTLS (try_ssl=2) connection security.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird Account Settings > Outgoing Server (SMTP), add server, set port and connection security dropdown.
metadata.explanation: Task checks that the Thunderbird SMTP server uses port 587 and STARTTLS (try_ssl=2 in prefs.js). Evaluator parses prefs.js after closing Thunderbird. Blank profile has no SMTP entry so initial state cannot pass. [Fixed: added check_ prefix to evaluator.func to match actual metric function name check_thunderbird_smtp_security__9cc78735939880d6658a6582ff470dcd]
fix_history: Fix 1: Updated evaluator.func from 'thunderbird_smtp_security__9cc78735939880d6658a6582ff470dcd' to 'check_thunderbird_smtp_security__9cc78735939880d6658a6582ff470dcd' to match the actual metric function name in metrics/thunderbird_smtp.py

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile with a fallback search if the default path is absent, reliably extracting SMTP port and try_ssl values.
Metric correctly checks port == 587 (+0.5) and try_ssl == 2 (STARTTLS, +0.5), matching the core requirements of the instruction.
Blank profile guarantees the initial state has no SMTP entries, so the evaluator scores 0 before the task is performed — negative-control resistance is sound.
Email address (anonym-x2024@outlook.com) is not verified: any SMTP server configured with port 587 and STARTTLS would pass, regardless of which account it belongs to.
The 'Do not set up any incoming email service' constraint is not checked: no inspection of IMAP/POP3 account entries in prefs.js.
Getter only returns the first SMTP server found (ports[0], ssls[0]); if multiple servers exist, only the first is evaluated.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a regex check in the getter to extract the SMTP server's associated email address (via mail.identity.*.smtpServer and mail.identity.*.useremail in prefs.js) and verify it matches anonym-x2024@outlook.com.
Add a check in the getter or metric that no IMAP/POP3 accounts are configured (e.g., assert no 'mail.server.*.type' entries with value 'imap' or 'pop3' exist in prefs.js).
Consider returning all SMTP servers (not just ports[0]) and checking that at least one matches the expected port and try_ssl, to handle profiles with multiple servers.
